description: Embedded real-time log dashboard for SinkSharp. Mounts on your existing ASP.NET Core app at the same host and port — no extra process, no extra port, no separate log viewer licence required. Features: real-time SignalR streaming, 500-event circular buffer replay, level and service filters, full-text and regex search, correlation ID copy to clipboard, shareable URL with active filters, JSON and CSV export, reconnect indicator, per-sink minimum level, 6 authentication modes, Redis multi-pod backplane.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.5 — v1.1 Dashboard features
• Added: Property filter panel — Props toolbar button; filter by any structured property key/value; dynamic key dropdown built from visible buffer; multiple filters AND-ed with level/text/time; filter badges with remove
• Added: Log event bookmarking/pinning — 🔖 button per row pins event to sticky Pinned section above log list; max 10 pins; oldest auto-dropped when limit reached; cleared on Clear All
• Added: "📌 Only" toolbar button — filters main log list to show only pinned events (non-pinned rows faded); auto-disables when last pin is removed
• Added: "⊞ Pinned" toolbar button — opens full-screen dedicated Pinned view (replaces log list); sticky header with count, Unpin all, Back to logs; clicking any row opens detail panel; auto-closes when last pin removed
• Both pinned toolbar buttons start disabled; enabled as soon as first event is pinned
v1.0.4 — Bug fixes
• Dashboard now connects in Worker Service / Console App — DashboardTokenStore DI registration was missing
• Dashboard auth mode now loads correctly in Worker / Console — __AUTH_MODE__ placeholder not replaced at startup
• CSV export renders special characters correctly — UTF-8 BOM added
v1.0.3 — Bug fixes: JS syntax error fixed; version labels corrected; CSV includes enriched properties
v1.0.2 — Bug fix: JS syntax error; Export split into JSON and CSV
v1.0.1 — New features: Copy correlation ID, shareable URL, regex search, buffer capacity, CSV export, reconnect indicator
v1.0.0 — Stable release: real-time SignalR streaming, 500-event buffer, level/service/search filters, 6 auth modes, Redis backplane
See full changelog: https://github.com/SinkSharp/CHANGELOG.md
